empty.title: You're all caught up
empty.description: Updates about your activities, followers and integrations will show up here.

error.title: Couldn't load notifications
error.description: Something went wrong while loading your notifications.

newActivity.title: New activity
newActivity.body: A new activity was added to your account.

duplicateActivity.title: Possible duplicate activity
duplicateActivity.body: An activity with the same start time may already exist.

garminTokenExpired.title: Garmin Connect needs attention
garminTokenExpired.body: Your Garmin Connect session expired. Reconnect it to keep syncing.

stravaTokenExpired.title: Strava needs attention
stravaTokenExpired.body: Strava rejected your connection. Reconnect it to keep syncing.
stravaTokenExpired.bodyRevoked: Strava access ended. Your Strava-synced activities and gear will be deleted on {date} unless you reconnect.

stravaDataDeleted.title: Strava data deleted
stravaDataDeleted.body: Your Strava-synced activities and gear were deleted because Strava access ended and you did not reconnect.

idpLinked.title: New sign-in provider linked
idpLinked.body: {name} was linked to your account. If this wasn't you, review your security settings.
idpLinked.bodyGeneric: A sign-in provider was linked to your account. If this wasn't you, review your security settings.

passwordChanged.title: Password changed
passwordChanged.body: Your password was changed. If this wasn't you, reset your password and review your security settings.

passwordReset.title: Password reset
passwordReset.body: Your password was reset using a reset link. If this wasn't you, reset your password again and review your security settings. Any API keys were revoked and any pending email change was cancelled.

passwordSetByAdmin.title: Password set by an administrator
passwordSetByAdmin.body: An administrator set a new password for your account. If you didn't expect this, contact your administrator. Any API keys were revoked and any pending email change was cancelled.

mfaEnabled.title: Two-factor authentication turned on
mfaEnabled.body: Two-factor authentication was turned on for your account. If this wasn't you, reset your password and review your security settings.

mfaDisabled.title: Two-factor authentication turned off
mfaDisabled.body: Two-factor authentication was turned off for your account. If this wasn't you, reset your password and review your security settings.

mfaResetByAdmin.title: Two-factor authentication reset by an administrator
mfaResetByAdmin.body: An administrator reset two-factor authentication for your account and signed you out of all devices. Set it up again from your security settings. If you didn't expect this, contact your administrator.

passwordChangeRequiredByAdmin.title: Password change required by an administrator
passwordChangeRequiredByAdmin.body: An administrator required you to change your password and signed you out of all devices. You will choose a new password the next time you sign in with your password. If you didn't expect this, contact your administrator.

backupCodesGenerated.title: New backup codes generated
backupCodesGenerated.body: New backup codes were generated for your account. If this wasn't you, reset your password and review your security settings.

apiKeyCreated.title: New API key created
apiKeyCreated.body: A new API key was created for your account. If this wasn't you, reset your password and review your security settings.

identityProviderUnlinked.title: Sign-in provider unlinked
identityProviderUnlinked.body: {name} was unlinked from your account. If this wasn't you, reset your password and review your security settings.
identityProviderUnlinked.bodyGeneric: A sign-in provider was unlinked from your account. If this wasn't you, reset your password and review your security settings.

accountLocked.title: Account locked
accountLocked.body: Your account was locked after 100 failed sign-in attempts in a row. Browsers and apps you have signed in from since your last security change can still sign in. If these attempts weren't yours, change or reset your password, which also lifts the lock.

mfaLocked.title: Two-step verification locked
mfaLocked.body: Your account was locked after 100 wrong two-step verification codes in a row, so someone knows your password. Browsers and apps you have signed in from since your last security change can still sign in. If these attempts weren't yours, change your password.

unknown.title: Account security changed
unknown.body: A security setting of your account changed. If this wasn't you, reset your password and review your security settings.

newDeviceSignIn.title: New sign-in
newDeviceSignIn.body: New sign-in from {browser} on {os} ({ip}). If this wasn't you, change your password and sign out of your other sessions.
